meta.title: Palm Court
meta.notes: One paid generation, extended once, with our title laid over it. The intro (palm-intro-t1, 8 s, from ch-palm-court-intro) was continued by the provider with the kitchen scene (ch-palm-court-kitchen, 10 s), which returns the source clip and its new tail as one 18 s file, palm-full-t1; its first 192 frames match the intro take (PSNR 35 dB or better on every frame) and the kitchen starts on frame 192 (8.0 s). compose.mjs then laid our pastel Palm Court script over it (gfx/palm-title.png, 6.2 s to 8.0 s, faded in over 0.5 s) and copied the sound, giving palm-full-titled, byte-identical to review/clips/ch-palm-court-take2.mp4. The two segments are the take's two scenes, in step. All the sound is the take's own: the theme under the intro, the three lines, the studio laugh. "Same night." from the storyboard isn't heard: it is lost under the laugh, so the last line ends on "Twice.". The theme and the laugh track are in the take's own sound, so they are music and sound-effect items that label it: the theme under the opening titles, the laugh from 7.5 s into the kitchen, after "Twice.", to the end.
